gi_sheet_census.note: Clips from the same vod are not independent observations for CIs. Do not fabricate ratings.

estimated_not_measured: Full-VOD GI quality lift (no human labels)
End-to-end detection recall on exhaustively annotated timelines
blocked_metrics: Paired source-level CI for A vs B
selection_bias_risks: gi-gta-label-sheet candidates come from ClutchClips proposals → proposal-biased precision
Wayin sheet is competitor-overlap proxy, not gaming-quality GT
YouNiverse pilot is reach-matched metadata; popularity ≠ highlight quality
Single VOD (gta-online-1) → clips not independent for CI
leakage_risks: Eval denylist VODs must stay out of training/calibration
Do not tune GI weights on held-out labels
Do not treat blank ratings as negatives

gates.name: human_label_reliability
gates.required_next: Collect dual ratings on ≥10 overlapping clips; adjudicate diffs ≥2.

gates.name: baseline_measured
gates.required_next: Complete ≥20 human ratings on Dataset B development or eval sheet.

gates.name: experimental_improves_metric
gates.required_next: Run fixed-pool A/B/C on identical candidates with held-out labels.

gates.name: improvement_vs_uncertainty
gates.required_next: Need enough independent source videos for source-level CI; do not claim significance early.

gates.name: processing_cost_acceptable
gates.required_next: Measure wall s / source hour, peak RSS, and $/source hour on identical VODs.

gates.name: generalizes_beyond_development
gates.required_next: Evaluate on held-out recordings (streamer-separated); never tune on those labels.

decision_gates.recommendation: Do not increase model complexity. Satisfy failing gates first.
